# Interzoid MCP

Match, standardize, and enrich organization, address, contact, and location data through Interzoid’s provider-hosted MCP server. Calls consume the connecting account’s API credits.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/interzoid-mcp/.
